verdict.rationale: Shopify documents UCP-shaped order webhooks pushed to a registered endpoint on committed order changes (fulfillment, refunds, returns, edits, cancellations). Deliveries are HMAC-SHA256 signed and retried up to 8 times over 4 hours. However, subscription is explicitly not self-serve: the URL and topic scoping are registered server-side through a Shopify partner manager, and the profile webhook_url field is not honored, so an agent cannot subscribe programmatically. Missing for 10: self-serve or programmatic subscription API, event coverage beyond order changes, hands-on evidence of webhook delivery.
